ipl-auction-player-study.description: Data-driven cricket analytics dashboard decoding the gap between IPL auction prices and on-field reality using 16+ years of ball-by-ball data to calculate objective player ROI.

cricket-iq-coach.description: Cricket IQ Coach — Analytics dashboard and coaching tool for cricket academies and teams. Track sessions, players, drills, and performance with Supabase + Next.js. Built for VIT-AP Prompt to Production.

CricSense.description: A deep learning project that automatically generates narrative summaries of cricket matches from ball-by-ball data using transformer models.

SmartML.description: SmartML is an end-to-end AutoML platform that turns raw CSV/Excel/JSON files into trained, benchmarked machine learning models without any code. It features a visual cleaning studio, automated model ranking, AI-powered dataset insights, and deployable exports.
